subject: Zephyr Health - AZ2 latency spike and routing governance request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@zephyrhealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, oliver.grant@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Zephyr Health - AZ2 latency & 502 surge (urgent)

Rafael,

We're seeing a sudden and sustained spike in request latency for our production traffic routed to AZ2 (westus2) starting ~08:45 PDT. Error rate climbed to ~12% 502s and tail latencies > 3s across several endpoints (search, inference). Our customers are complaining; ticket volume is rising.

I attached a short haproxy sample with repeat 502s. Can you confirm whether this is a regional (AZ2) problem or something in our integration? We need an immediate mitigation plan, ideally cross-region steering while you triage.

Also looped Oliver (SRE) and Neha from CS for customer comms. Please advise if we should approve a temporary redirect to westus3.

--
Samantha Lee
Platform Ops, Zephyr Health
samantha@zephyrhealth.com

Attachment: haproxy-502-sample.log (text, 45KB)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health - AZ2 latency & 502 surge (urgent)

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for the log. We're seeing consistent telemetry that points to elevated 5xx and queueing in westus2 AZ2 host groups; causes not yet final. Immediate plan:

1) Short-term (next 20m): steer Zephyr traffic from westus2/AZ2 -> westus3 to reduce customer impact. This will be a DNS/edge routing change with the platform policy set to maintain session affinity for 30m.
2) Mid-term (1–3h): run health checks and drain problematic AZ2 backends, collect full kibana snapshot (happening now), and validate request fanout.
3) Exec/customer comms: Vanessa/Neha are you able to coordinate the external update in the next 30 minutes? We'll include estimated ETA for restoration and the mitigation steps.

Ask: We need explicit permission from Zephyr to perform a temporary redirect. If Oliver/Zephyr approves, we'll execute the steer and follow with postmortem notes. There may be slight increased latency for users pinned to westus3 (region hop), but throughput and error rate should improve.

CC'ing Hannah and Marcus to own ops and kernel-level assessment. Hannah — once you confirm, I'll file the routing request and notify the edge team.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Customer Escalations — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: routing-request-20270404.pdf (stub)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health - AZ2 latency & 502 surge (urgent)

On Sun, Apr 4, 2027 at 09:12, rafael_mendes@redwood.com wrote:
> Hannah — once you confirm, I'll file the routing request and notify the edge team.

Confirmed. Quick operational notes:
- Observed: AZ2 kvcache saturation on sequence-heavy flows + one load-balancer backend group showing 502 bursts. We've isolated the group (host-pool 12a) and started graceful drains.
- Impact: latency tails hitting 3–5s for long-context requests; short requests also see elevated p95.
- Mitigation started: draining host-pool 12a now; initiating cross-region steer to westus3 (edge team notified, request queued).
- Data / safety: no customer data loss expected; KV cache miss rate will increase after steer for some warm sessions (acceptable trade-off).

I uploaded a Kibana snapshot to the incident folder: https://kibana.redwood/zephyr/az2-20270404 and attached ndjson. We'll capture kernel traces and delayed-io histograms if drains don't improve within 30m.

Next steps (ops owners): Marcus to run quick kernel-level regression check (recent runtime patch rolled 03/31). Rafael to confirm steer authorization. Neha/Vanessa to coordinate customer message.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer

Attachment: kibana-snapshot-az2-20270404.ndjson (snapshot, 12MB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@zephyrhealth.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, oliver.grant@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health - AZ2 latency & 502 surge (urgent)

Samantha / Oliver — I can confirm Zephyr's approval to proceed with the temporary redirect to westus3. Oliver, please confirm if you want us to maintain session affinity for 30m or shorter.

Customer comms: Neha and I will send a status note to the customer base in the next 15 minutes noting the mitigation (traffic reroute) and expected follow-up. We should also prepare a commercial ask: 1) one-time credit for outage window, and 2) a joint postmortem with remediation commitments. Rafael — can you flag this to Finance/RevOps so we can expedite a provisional credit approval if the postmortem shows platform responsibility?

Finally, scheduling: I'll set up a 30-min exec bridge at 13:00 PDT for an update and to review the cutover timeline and any SLA implications. Please add incident artifacts to the Atlassian ticket (INF-4821).

Thanks everyone — will update once steer completes.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
